ledger: Gravity on tabletop objects: coins lie flat, cups sit upright, held coin hangs from fingers (0:00) — gravity acts consistently on all loose objects

Coin-in-cup interaction: coins visible inside cups at 0:00-0:02 remain in place as hands work around cups — no unexplained displacement
Indoor air: no airflow implied anywhere; dealer's tie, lapels, pocket square, and background figures all static across 0:00-0:08 — consistent still-air environment
Camera pull-back (0:04-0:08): apparent background sweep from camera motion only; no object deformation (flutter, sway) accompanies it, correctly attributing motion to the camera
Lighting/shadows: soft shadows under cups, coins, and the hand hold consistent direction and softness across all shots, matching the window-lit interior seen at 0:06-0:08
